_about: AN/APG-68(V)9 fire-control radar, game-level model for flight/weapons/radar.js. Sources per field in docs/flight-notes/f16-radar.md; ESTIMATE = guessed from public figures, not from a primary source.
_r50nm: ESTIMATE: range (nm) at which a 1 m^2 target is seen with Pd 0.5 per look, look-up, no clutter. Public figures for the (V)9 vs a fighter-size target are ~40-45 nm; 30 nm x 5^(1/4) = 44.9 nm for 5 m^2.
_snrRef: dB: SNR at r50 (Pd 0.5 per look); Pd per look = 1 / (1 + exp(-(SNR - snrRef) / pdSlope)). ESTIMATE
_beamDeg: ESTIMATE: two-way 3 dB beam width of a ~0.74 m X-band planar array (lambda 3 cm: 70 lambda / D ~ 2.8 deg one-way)
_barDeg: ESTIMATE: bar spacing (bars overlap: beam 3.5 deg)
_scanDegS: ESTIMATE: antenna azimuth rate; A6 4B frame = 4 x 120 / 60 = 8 s
_gimbalDeg: DCS F-16C guide p.379: scan volume +-60 deg az

rws._fade: track kept for fade x frame time after its last hit (ESTIMATE)

tws._coast: ESTIMATE: s a TWS track is extrapolated without a hit

acm._acm: 30 x 20 deg box, body stabilised (DCS guide p.381/384), auto-lock within 10 nm; box from 3 deg below to 17 deg above the boresight: ESTIMATE

stt._coast: ESTIMATE: s of memory before a lost STT drops

clutter._clutter: ESTIMATE: look-down = main beam on the ground behind the target: -3 dB; target Doppler inside the sidelobe clutter band (|closing| < own ground speed): -6 dB more; notch = |target radial speed over the ground| < 30 m/s (~60 kt): not seen

_autoEl: game aid (not the jet): with no ANT ELEV control, the CRM scan centre steps through these elevations (deg) after each frame without a hit
